title: Spectral freeze with a bounded per-callback cost and stationary long holds

needles: static constexpr int due_steps(int total, std::int64_t elapsed,
FreezeHold running average makes latch cost independent of capture length
FreezeHold rotor synthesis performs no transcendental per held hop
FreezeHold long hold across a change keeps the older sound audible
FreezeHold peak-lobe phase lock keeps short-term level stationary from the start
StagedTransition runs each step once, in order, when due

installed_sdk.rationale: Pulp::signal installs both headers through the per-subsystem include install. FreezeHold gains opt-in Config fields (rotor synthesis, staged engage, running-sum averaging, energy-weighted frequency, peak-lobe phase lock) whose defaults render bit-identically, and StagedTransition is the reusable schedule for spreading bounded transition work across callbacks. Both are in-process audio-owner primitives with allocation-free audio paths.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: The cost modes and the staging helper are streaming audio-owner primitives composed inside a processor; they add no offline Timeline command.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: The primitives are consumed by processors and add no MCP operation.

live_product_control.rationale: No Product A control surface is added; a product chooses the hold's Config at prepare and drives the hold from its audio thread.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: freeze_hold.hpp and staged_transition.hpp are recorded in the public-surface ledger as reviewed infrastructure with no capability key of their own.
